text: This solution, National Disaster Risk Reduction Framework (NDRRF) 2017–2030 addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between National Disaster Centre (NDC) of Papua New Guinea, Government of Papua New Guinea departments and agencies, United Nations Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction, Framework for Resilient Development in the Pacific (FRDP) 2017–2030, and APEC Disaster Risk Reduction Plan. The program was implemented in 2017 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and regulation.
